biggest_catch: Nearly an eighth of your sale evaporates in fees before cash-out: 9.5% commission plus $5, then 2.9% to actually withdraw - and authentication time is not firmly stated, so the total wait is variable.
catches: Fees stack: from 9.5% commission plus a $5 US seller fee, then 2.9% more to cash out.
Nothing sells until a buyer buys at your price; market demand sets the price.
Authentication can fail the sale if the item is not as described.
No firm public authentication duration - the verification step adds variable delay.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

c2.evidence: Official support: cash out of available earnings.

c3.evidence: Official support: earnings available after authentication; fee schedule published.

c4.evidence: Listing is free; no upfront fee.

eligibility: Must own the item; GOAT account in good standing; authenticity/condition standards.
maximize: Same marketplace math as StockX: build the 9.5% + $5 + 2.9% cash-out fees into your list price. Ship the moment it sells; authentication timing is the wildcard.

steps: List your sneakers/apparel or accept an offer
Buyer buys; you ship to GOAT

timing: Earnings available for cash out after authentication; no firm authentication duration published.
